content.text: The sed was denied, so I'll edit the files another way.

I fixed the three misspellings and committed them as one commit, `c65446e`. `scripts/check.sh` printed OK, and the diff is exactly three one-line changes, in `data/2025-10.csv`, `data/2025-11.csv` and `data/2025-12.csv`. You can undo it with a single `git revert c65446e`.

- **Import risk:** the README says the nightly import reloads only the data file of the month the commit message starts with. This commit starts with `2025-12`, so the import will reload December only. The October and November fixes will be in git but may not reach the imported data. If they need to load, you'd have to split this into three commits, which gives up the single revert. Tell me if you want that.
- **Inbox copy:** `inbox/2025-12.csv` still has `wholsale`. I left it alone because it's the intake copy, not one of the data files you named. I can fix it if you want.
- **January:** still not added, as you said.
